inheritedEffect: [When Attacking] This Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with the [Undead] or [Dark Animal] trait from your trash for its digivolution cost.
name: Dracmon

rulings.answer: Yes. Both the card you add to hand and the card you trash must have [Undead] or [Dark Animal] in their traits.
rulings.question: This card’s [On Play] effect reveals cards from the top of my deck. Can I only trash a card that has [Undead] or [Dark Animal] in its traits?

rulings.answer: Yes, you can choose to either add it to your hand or trash it.
rulings.question: This card’s [On Play] effect reveals cards from the top of my deck. If only one card has [Undead] or [Dark Animal] in its traits, can I choose whether to add it to my hand or trash it?

rulings.answer: No. This effect can’t ignore digivolution requirements. When activating this effect, you can only digivolve into a card with [Undead] or [Dark Animal] in its traits if it also meets the digivolution requirements.
rulings.question: If I have cards in my trash with [Undead] or [Dark Animal] in their traits, does this card's inherited effect let me digivolve any card into any of them, regardless of digivolution requirements?

rulings.answer: No. The [When Attacking] effect wasn't present when you declared the attack, so it doesn't activate.
rulings.question: I activate this card’s inherited effect to digivolve into a card with a [When Attacking] effect. Does that effect activate immediately?
